title: A company brings its rivals
blurb: A description became a set one change ago; a named company still got a profile of itself, which is a different question from the one a competitive landscape tool is asked. The queries that find the rest are templated from the company's own name for itself, read off its own front page — the case FACT_CHECKING P22 was written for rather than the exception the description path had to argue for. Reading one box now has three answers: nothing named is searched for, one named seeds a landscape, and several named are exactly those, because a reader who writes two domains has said what to compare.
